description_en: Eleftherios Venizelos led Greece during World War I, joining the Allies, and later during the Greco-Turkish War (1919-1922), leading Greece to victory in the war but facing the catastrophic defeat in Asia Minor (current Turkey) and the subsequent Greek Civil War.
